axes: Unity space: +X right, +Y up, +Z forward (the building front). Origin = plot centre on the ground.
uv: UV0 and UV1 = palette swatch (cell centre of a 5 x 5 grid; point filtering).

lod.naming: <Name>_LOD0.._LOD2 meshes in one FBX (Unity makes the LOD Group)

colliders: Boxes: centre, size (Unity space); yaw = Unity euler Y in degrees.
markers: RoofPad = landing pad (spawn, Lifter objectives); Roof = clear circle on a flat roof (objective zones). Position = surface point; radius = clear circle (checked by the audit).
